Hong · Listen & Shadow 09

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE INTERVIEW ROOM
👤 Interviewer
Tell me about a time you worked under pressure.
under pressure — in a hard, busy situation
💬 Hong
One example that comes to mind is a national holiday at the museum.
comes to mind — is the first thing I think of
같은 패턴으로 — One example that comes to mind is my first week. · One example that comes to mind is a rainy Sunday.
💬 Hong
At that point, there were far more visitors than we expected.
at that point — at that moment in the story · far more — much more
같은 패턴으로 — At that point, the line reached the door. · At that point, two staff had already left.
💬 Hong
So what I did was take one guest at a time and stay calm.
so what I did was ~ — this is how I responded
같은 패턴으로 — So what I did was call my manager first. · So what I did was write everything down.
💬 Hong
What I learned was: stay calm, pick priorities, then handle them one by one.
priority — the thing that matters most right now · one by one — one after another
같은 패턴으로 — What I learned was: ask first, then act. · What I learned was: slow down before you speak.
💬 Hong
In the end, the day ran smoothly because the team moved together.
in the end — finally, after everything · run smoothly — go without trouble
같은 패턴으로 — In the end, everyone got in. · In the end, we finished early.
💬 Hong
Looking back, what I learned was how to work under pressure.
looking back — thinking about it now
같은 패턴으로 — Looking back, it was good training. · Looking back, I'd do the same thing.
PART 2 · THE CASH STORY
👤 Interviewer
Tell me about a time you went beyond your duties.
go beyond your duties — do more than your job asks
💬 Hong
A foreign high school student came to the exhibition with only cash.
exhibition — a show or display for visitors · cash — paper money
같은 패턴으로 — A guest came to the counter with only a phone. · A visitor arrived with no ticket.
💬 Hong
The museum accepted card payments only, and the fee wasn't high.
accept — take, allow · fee — the price you pay to enter
같은 패턴으로 — The shop accepted cards only. · The fee wasn't high, so no one complained.
💬 Hong
So I paid with my own card to help him get in.
own — belonging to me · get in — enter
같은 패턴으로 — So I paid with my own card and sorted it later. · So I used my own phone to book it.
💬 Hong
He thanked me and handed me his cash.
hand — give with your hand
같은 패턴으로 — She thanked me and handed me a note. · He handed me his ticket and smiled.
💬 Hong
It was a small amount, but the moment stayed with me.
amount — how much money · stay with someone — be remembered for a long time
같은 패턴으로 — It was a small thing, but it stayed with me. · The words stayed with me for years.
💬 Hong
This experience taught me that a small favour goes a long way.
favour — a kind act · go a long way — have a big effect
같은 패턴으로 — This experience taught me that people remember kindness. · This experience taught me that asking helps.

these days — recently

in the first place — at the very beginning

it started when ~ — this is where it began

basically — simply put · run a program — organise and lead an activity

👤 Friend
When did English stop being just a school subject for you?
subject — a class you study at school
💬 Hong
English stopped being a school subject when guests started asking me things.
stop being ~ — no longer be ~
같은 패턴으로 — It stopped being homework when I needed it at work. · It stopped being scary after a while.
💬 Hong
I picked most of it up from talking to visitors.
pick up — learn without studying
같은 패턴으로 — I picked it up from movies. · She picked up Japanese from her coworkers.
💬 Hong
I can get by in Japanese — just a little.
get by — manage with what you have
같은 패턴으로 — I can get by in Chinese. · I can get by with basic phrases.
💬 Hong
That's part of why I want this job.
part of why — one of the reasons
같은 패턴으로 — That's part of why I applied. · That's part of why I stayed.
💬 Hong
I'd like to work where the whole world walks past me every day.

같은 패턴으로 — I'd like to work where every day looks different. · I'd like to work where I meet people from everywhere.
